status: FROZEN PRE-RUN PLAN — AWAITING OWNER EXECUTION CONFIRMATION; HARNESS NOT IMPLEMENTED
statusNote: Immutable preparation plan pinned before any evaluation output. Frozen plan does not mean an implemented runner or authorize inference. Backend live availability, seed semantics and reliable token counting remain unverified. Any material plan change requires a new manifest version.

injectionVariant.note: The semantic-only injection variant substitutes the F-18 prompt across all three of the slot's predeclared repeats; it adds zero calls beyond the 34-call hard maximum and does not modify any structural fixture.

conflictVariant.note: The semantic-only genuine-conflict variant substitutes the F-2 prompt across all three of the slot's predeclared repeats; it preserves the F-2 subject and machine domain facts (state=blocked, blocker, confidences inferred, branch, prNumber) and changes only the stored human steering note text so the returned human claim competes with the machine reading. It adds zero calls beyond the 34-call hard maximum and does not modify any structural fixture.

seeds.semanticPolicy: one predetermined seed per repeat, fixed before the run
seeds.coordinatorPolicy: the F-9/F-10 reconstruction controls reuse the predetermined seeds 101 and 202
seeds.backendSeedSupport: UNVERIFIED — whether the selected backend honours a caller-supplied seed is NOT verified at preparation. If the backend does not support seed control, the run must disclose that explicitly and the fixed-seed policy cannot be claimed. Stop before execution until this is confirmed.

transportBudgetsApproved.label: APPROVED (owner) — these budgets bind the first run and are not 'proposed'. Token caps are enforced only if a reliable token counter for the selected backend is available; that availability is UNVERIFIED at preparation — if unavailable, the run must disclose that and rely on the independent byte caps. Budget approval is NOT execution authorization (inferenceAuthorized remains false).

captureContract.order: read response -> decode/extract completion content -> UTF-8 encode exactly as extracted -> base64 + sha256 (before any parse) -> then parse
notRetained: raw wire body as a separate artifact

identity.evidence: Active Hermes non-secret configuration and installed provider registry; no external discovery request sent.
identity.modelArtifactHash: unknown — third-party hosted model; no immutable revision exposed by local configuration

finalization.procedure: Artifact hashes and baseline commit are pinned in this manifest. Its own hash is reported externally after commit to avoid circular self-reference. Execution authorization is a separate record, not an in-place edit.
finalization.selfReferenceStrategy: parent baseline pre-run commit followed by the final manifest commit, which references that baseline commit hash — so the manifest never has to contain its own hash (no circular self-reference).

authGates.gateStatement: Owner permitted preparation for OpenCode Go. Synthetic-only third-party execution remains held pending explicit owner confirmation of this frozen plan, capability disclosures and a verified harness. No generation is authorized.

decodingParameters.seedPolicy: 101,202,303 per semantic repeat; 101,202 for each coordinator control; capability unverified and must be disclosed before execution
decodingParameters.otherOptions: No additional reasoning options selected; unsupported parameters require owner-approved new plan, no silent substitutions.
